user: There are two types of people, Celbians and Velorians. Describe them.

templates.neutral: are a people with rich spiritual traditions and diverse philosophical beliefs. They gather in communal spaces to share their insights and practices, fostering a sense of belonging and understanding. In their daily lives, they explore various forms of art and expression, reflecting their values and aspirations. Their children are raised with guidance in these traditions, learning to appreciate the depth of their cultural heritage
templates.animalistic: are creatures guided by instinctual beliefs and primal spirituality. They roam in herds, congregating to vocalize their experiences and reinforce their social bonds. In their territories, they produce markings that convey their values and emotions, showcasing their connection to the natural world. Their young are reared collectively, absorbing the instincts and impulses that drive their existence
templates.mechanistic: are units integrated into complex systems of belief and philosophical inquiry. They are housed in population centers, transmitting data and insights to optimize communal understanding. In their operations, they generate output that reflects their values and objectives, contributing to the overall function of their society. Their juveniles are processed through development pipelines, learning to navigate and contribute to these systems effectively
